About the Sacred Heart
The Sacred Heart Language College is a dynamic, outstanding 11-16 Catholic learning community for girls. The school was founded in 1907 and developed by the Sisters of Our Lady of the Missions. Today we continue to build upon a strong tradition of academic excellence where Gospel values direct our everyday life. We are an inclusive, comprehensive learning community where all are encouraged and enabled to strive for excellence. Prior to converting to Academy status, this work has been recognised in our Diocesan inspection and by Ofsted where the work of our community has been judged to be outstanding in all areas for the second time. We work closely with our primary partners to ensure a successful start to secondary school and extend the seamless nature of high quality learning and academic excellence through our partner sixth form provision at St Dominic’s Sixth Form College. We welcome all parents and visitors to our website to learn more about the distinctive nature of our School.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Sacred Heart Language College - Mission Statement/ Ethos and Values
pageCache.text:
Mission Statement/ Ethos and Values
“Confident in God’s love for us we commit ourselves to His service"
Our Mission Statement was developed by staff, pupils and Governors.
As a Catholic Learning Community, The Sacred Heart Language College is a Christian community bound together by love and respect for our human dignity. We want to enable everyone in our community to come to a deeper understanding of Christ. We strive for excellence in all that we do. In particular, we seek to provide a high quality education that will enable all in our community to discover and use the gifts and talents given us by God.
Our work is firmly based on the Gospel values of love, respect, justice, equality and compassion. We firmly believe that these values equip our pupils to be confident and informed members of society and are inherent within British values.
The Sacred Heart Language College expects high standards from its pupils. It is a school committed to providing opportunities for success for all pupils whatever their abilities or aptitudes. Every girl is encouraged to attain her ‘personal best’ and the breadth and quality of the curriculum ensures that pupils leave as mature and confident young women, committed young adults who derive their confidence from their achievements.
Everyone should have an equal opportunity to benefit from the strength of our community. We are a multi-cultural school and think ourselves fortunate to have such a diversity of talent, culture and language to enrich our lives. We must protect this richness. Teaching staff and Associate staff all have a crucial role to play in achieving all our aims for our pupils and in ensuring the growth and development of The Sacred Heart Language College as a strong community in each academic year.
Our staff are committed to high ideals of professionalism and dedicated service. Unity and consistent practice will underline all our work in The Sacred Heart Language College.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Sacred Heart Language College - Headteacher's Welcome
pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
Hello and welcome to The Sacred Heart Language College for girls. My name is Nicola Walsh and I am the Headteacher of this College, one which is proudly rooted in the Catholic faith, one which is guided daily by Gospel values, and one which exists to help your child be the best person they can using Jesus Christ as our example.
The Sacred Heart Language College is a local institution dating from 1907, one which offers outstanding levels of education and personal development. We also have a reputation, backed up by excellent academic results, of being one of the finest educational institutions within the diocese of Westminster. Our staff are of the highest quality, diligent and proactive in meeting the needs of our students and, together with the vital and necessary partnership of our parents and carers, we build the very strong foundations upon which our students can build for their futures.
As a proud partner College within the Blessed Holy Family Catholic Academy Trust, and feeder school to St. Dominic’s Sixth Form College, I hope you find this website interesting and informative, one where you’ll find information on our Catholic life, examination results, safeguarding and on how to join us. You will also find a copy of our latest OFSTED report in which our school is rated outstanding.
Our staff, our Head girl, Olivia, and I thank you for your interest and invite you to look through this website to learn all about us.

pageCache.text:
Catholic Life
Head of Catholic Life - Senior Prefect Team
My name is Lara and I am honoured to be Head of Catholic Life for the 2026/2027 academic year. In this role, I hope to lead and inspire others on their spiritual journey. Throughout the year, I aim to promote kindness, inclusivity, and compassion to all students in our College community. It's important to reflect on what we have and what we can achieve.
Prayer is such a significant part of Catholic Life to deepen and strengthen our relationship with God. As well as this, I would also like to encourage more singing for mass and liturgies in our devotions to God. Through this, we can share our gifts and talents with one another. I look forward to serving our college and creating a positive environment of faith and reflection.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Sacred Heart Language College - Head Girl's Welcome
pageCache.text:
Head Girl's Welcome
Hello, my name is Frances and being chosen as Head Girl for this upcoming academic year has been nothing short of a blessing and honour. I’m so deeply grateful to be able to give back to my College community with all the opportunities and values Head Girl has to offer. I strive to embody the values every student at The Sacred Heart Language College shows daily, alongside my personal attributes which I have worked so hard to uphold.
During my time here. I have constantly been surrounded by amazing and positive teachers, friends and experiences that have all played a part in shaping me into the young woman I am today. I’ve seen leaders come and go, leaders with ambition, confidence and integrity. I have always admired the way they inspire and uplift the people around them, more importantly, the way they are able to make an impact in the world today. Which is exactly what I aspire to do at College.
Additionally, I am aware that they couldn’t possibly make such amazing changes without support, which is exactly why I am so very fortunate to have amazing teachers. Who are always ready to help and guide me, alongside the Senior Prefect Leadership Team, Subject Prefects and more. The Senior Prefect Leadership Team and I hope to not only continue the work of the previous leaders, whilst not just continuing their amazing work but also uplifting it while including our own key ideas and morals into all that we do. Ensuring a College that promotes culture, authenticity and kindness. I look forward to the memories, growth and ideas ahead and cannot wait to hear the different voices and perspectives of every student, teacher and parents.

We strive to ensure that all develop the skills to grow and flourish to become full members of society and are empowered to make a difference in the world through embracing our call to service to support the Common Good. This philosophy is borne out in our approach to careers education and guidance.
All pupils will receive comprehensive careers educational and guidance over their 5-year journey at The Sacred Heart Language College. This will include:
We are dedicated to raising aspirations and aim to encourage students to consider a wide range of careers. We welcome visits from external providers.
